newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma to sell unit to Aker.
newsitem.headline: Rauma to sell unit to Aker.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Tuesday it would sell its Mantyluoto engineering works to Norwegian Aker Maritime ASA, part of industrial holding group Aker RGI ASA.
"Both parties have agreed not to reveal the acquisition price," Rauma said.
Mantyluoto Works specialises in building heavy steel structures for oil and gas production platforms. The unit's annual net sales are around 200 million markka and it has 510 employees, Rauma said.

"The divestment will strengthen Rauma's strategic concentration on four main business groups," it said, referring to its Timberjack forest machines, Sunds Defibrator fibre processing technology, Nordberg rock crushing and Neles-Jamesbury industrial valves units.
